findings.reason: the plan's own §3 repairs (test-ledger-reads-only-its-own-state, the follow-lifetime home-snapshot fix) each hand-roll scoping; naming tests/conftest.py as the owner and one shared isolated-home fixture would make those nodes extend it instead of adding a 55th copy.
findings.text: the isolated-home mechanism is re-declared as `crew_home` (19 files), `isolated_home` (22 files) and `config_home` (12 files) — 54 files total — while the owner `tests/conftest.py` provides none, so §3's "scope the outside-state guard / read a synthetic checkout" repairs add more per-file instances of isolation rather than extending one fixture

findings.reason: the guard's set is a deliberate superset (squeue/scontrol/scancel too) with a different purpose from placement's reservation verbs, so the guard cannot simply import placement's tuple; a comment naming placement.py as the source is enough, not a restructure.
findings.text: the guard's allocation-verb vocabulary `_ALLOCATION_VERBS = ("salloc", "sbatch", "srun")` re-encodes scheduler verbs already owned by `reckon/crew/placement.py:52` (`RESERVATION_SCHEDULER = "salloc"`, `RESERVATION_STEP_SCHEDULER = "srun"`)

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §3 adds no module; its bounded-run behaviour is carried by suite-wide conftest fixtures used once per session, so there is no spread of new shallow wrappers introduced by this design.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the "give this test its own RECKON_HOME" mechanism is re-implemented as a local fixture in 54 test files while `_SCHEDULER_VERBS` re-encodes scheduler verbs owned by `reckon/crew/placement.py`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1470, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §3 changes tests/conftest.py and test files only and adds nothing to any of the four families, so there is no added surface to retire or justify.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §3 extends the existing session reaper `reaped_watch_producers` (tests/conftest.py:465) and the existing scheduler-reach guard `_SCHEDULER_VERBS` (tests/conftest.py:223) rather than adding a runner, and it reuses the peer-added pytest-timeout/pytest-xdist (d4c5a54a) instead of building its own bound/parallel mechanism.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the fixed-wait removals replace a local sleep with a local bounded wait on the same observed condition; no new layer is interposed over an existing reader.
